# HexPiece 3.9.1

Your word on the mace: "I think the swing needs more leverage". **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 15 test suites pass;
all 63 sword animations passed the body check (no arm through the body, nothing through the head, never into the floor, every half
tick) and were rendered.

## Iron Mace: more leverage
- **The whole body loads into every swing now:** the mace is wound further back round its arc before the blow (about a fifth
  further), the hips and shoulders twisted a third harder into the wind-up and dropped lower under it, then the body turns further
  through the hit into the follow-through. Still cocked slowly and swung fast, the hits on the same ticks.
- Where the full wind-up took the 2.5-block mace too far, it is held back a little: the kesa, the makko and the side cut keep their
  height in the wind-up (the mace's end went into the floor behind), and the pivot cut, already a full spin, keeps its own.
- If you meant the Saber's (Gryphon's) swings too, tell me and they get the same.
